title: Deep learning on H&E slides predicts recurrence risk in HR-positive breast cancer
summary: Lunit SCOPE was trained on H&E slides from 1343 patients to predict Oncotype DX risk and recurrence. Among 363 patients who received no adjuvant therapy, 104 predicted high risk had significantly lower survival, and predicted risk correlated with proliferation-associated genes. The authors say it identifies early-stage patients likely to benefit from adjuvant chemotherapy; the study is retrospective, single-center, and a formal treatment-interaction test was not located in the material read.
ai_technology: Lunit SCOPE deep-learning histology analysis of H&E slides

evidence.tested: Retrospective training with 190 slides held out, a prognosis validation cohort and TCGA cohorts.
evidence.unknown: Whether chemotherapy benefit is confirmed by an interaction test; effect sizes beyond 104 of 363 were not extracted.
evidence.ai_role: Predicts Oncotype DX risk and recurrence from H&E images
